notes: Source: manufacturer spec sheet PDF (modulo-pi.com), Hardware Revision 2024-1, dated 23/07/2024. The "Modulo Player Pro" family ships in 7 SKUs with two different physical video-output configurations: MP-PRO-1, MP-PRO-2 and MP-PRO-4 have 4 x full-size DisplayPort 1.4 (with 1, 2 or 4 outputs active respectively, or reconfigurable to 1 output up to 4K on MP-PRO-4); MP-PRO-6, MP-PRO-2x4K, MP-PRO-3x4K and MP-PRO-4x4K instead have 6 x mini-DisplayPort 1.4 (up to 2/3/4 of the 6 outputs runnable at 4K depending on model). This entry documents the MP-PRO-4 configuration (4 x full-size DP 1.4) as representative; swap connector/count to "mini-dp" x6 for the -6/-2x4K/-3x4K/-4x4K SKUs. A complimentary active DisplayPort-to-HDMI adapter (1 per output) and EU power cord ship in the box but are accessories, not native ports. No built-in audio I/O ships on the unit — the spec sheet states "Add any USB or PCIE pro sound card," so audio ports were omitted rather than assumed. Optional add-on cards not included in base I/O: DELTA-series live-capture cards (2x3G-SDI up to 6x12G-SDI, or 2x4K-HDMI 2.0, or mixed SDI+HDMI) and TC-series timecode reader/generator cards (PCIe or USB). AC inlet connector sub-type is inferred (standard IEC C13/C14), not explicitly confirmed from the source document's text/imagery.
